groups.text: «holds» в значении «содержит» → «contains». В спецификации «hold» значит ещё и «быть верным» (a reason holds), и два смысла путаются.
«stands in / on» в значении «находится» → «is in», «is kept in», «is set out in». По-английски «stand in» значит «замещать».
«at a push / at a commit» → «on a push». Решить одну форму на всю спецификацию.
Безглагольное «So not X, but Y» в правилах о том, как писать узел → «So a rule says not X but Y».
«the one source of truth» → «the single source of truth», устойчивое выражение.
«contracts» как имя части с глаголом в единственном числе («Contracts agrees») → «the contracts section». Решение на всю спецификацию.
Абсолютные обороты «a section left out», «… included» → «except …», «including …».

findings.was: Where it needs to, a node also refers to other nodes, by links of several types.
findings.proposed: Where needed, a node also refers to other nodes through links of various types.
findings.why: «Where it needs to» и «by links of several types» — дословный перенос; носитель скажет «Where needed» и «through links of various types».
findings.title: The specification is the set of its nodes

findings.was: The basic structure of the specification
findings.proposed: The overall structure of the specification
findings.why: «basic structure» — калька «базовая структура»: читается как «примитивная структура» и путается с base specification.
findings.title: The basic structure of the specification

findings.was: The specification is made of three main parts
findings.proposed: The specification consists of three main parts
findings.why: «is made of» говорят о материале, а о составе документа — «consists of».
findings.title: The basic structure of the specification

findings.was: may be divided into parts, as sections
findings.proposed: may be divided into sections
findings.why: «into parts, as sections» — калька «на части в виде разделов»; по-английски достаточно «into sections».
findings.title: The basic structure of the specification

findings.was: With the appendix divided as the base is, the implementation of a rule is looked for in one place.
findings.proposed: With the appendix divided the same way as the base, there is only one place to look for a rule's implementation.
findings.why: Безличное «ищут» передано пассивом «is looked for», который по-английски звучит неуклюже.
findings.title: The basic structure of the specification

findings.was: It may also hold any further business information needed to understand the rule exactly
findings.proposed: It may also contain any further business information needed to understand the rule precisely
findings.why: «hold» для «содержит» и «understand exactly» — кальки; естественно «contain» и «understand precisely».
findings.title: The base specification states what the system does

findings.was: may be named by example
findings.proposed: may be named as an example
findings.why: «by example» значит «собственным примером», а «в качестве примера» — «as an example».
findings.title: The base specification states what the system does

findings.was: on another technical stack
findings.proposed: on another technology stack
findings.why: Устойчивый термин — «technology stack», а «technical stack» звучит как калька.
findings.title: The base specification states what the system does

findings.was: It also holds all the technical detail needed
findings.proposed: It also contains all the technical detail needed
findings.why: «holds» — калька «содержит»; о содержимом документа говорят «contains».
findings.title: The technical appendix describes how the rules are implemented

findings.was: It describes them in the detail an agent needs to implement them.
findings.proposed: It describes them in as much detail as an agent needs to implement them.
findings.why: «in the detail an agent needs» неидиоматично; нужна конструкция «in as much detail as».
findings.title: The technical appendix describes how the rules are implemented

findings.was: How a rule is carried out has no other home
findings.proposed: How a rule is implemented has no other home
findings.why: «carried out» — калька «выполняется»; речь о реализации правила, то есть «implemented».
findings.title: The technical appendix describes how the rules are implemented

findings.was: Described less exactly
findings.proposed: Described less precisely
findings.why: С «described» носитель скажет «precisely», а «exactly» звучит неестественно.
findings.title: The technical appendix describes how the rules are implemented

findings.was: The code would then hold that choice, and the specification would not.
findings.proposed: That choice would then be recorded in the code, not in the specification.
findings.why: «the code would hold that choice» — калька «выбор держал бы код»; код выбор не «держит», а в нём он записан.
findings.title: The technical appendix describes how the rules are implemented

findings.was: A particular project may extend
findings.proposed: A project may extend
findings.why: «particular» — калька «конкретный»: в английском слово лишнее и намекает на некий особый проект.
findings.title: What the guidelines govern

findings.was: One node holds only one numbered rule.
findings.proposed: A node contains only one numbered rule.
findings.why: «One node holds» — калька «Один узел содержит»; по-английски «A node contains».
findings.title: One node, one rule

findings.was: belong to that node rather than standing beside it
findings.proposed: belong to that node rather than to nodes beside it
findings.why: «belong … rather than standing» соединяет несогласованные формы глагола, а «standing beside» — калька «стоят рядом».
findings.title: One node, one rule

findings.was: would invent a second set of locations
findings.proposed: would create a second set of locations
findings.why: «invent» значит «выдумать», а речь о том, что второй набор расположений появился бы.
findings.title: One node, one rule

findings.was: A node, and so the rule, is cited
findings.proposed: A node, and so its rule, is cited
findings.why: «the rule» не говорит, какое правило; нужно «its rule».
findings.title: A node is cited by its sid

findings.was: A specification that grows is reordered
findings.proposed: As a specification grows, it is reordered
findings.why: «A specification that grows is reordered» звучит как определение особого вида спецификаций, а не как описание процесса.
findings.title: A node is cited by its sid

findings.was: moving a node changes its location but never the sid itself, which means that no reference using the sid breaks
findings.proposed: moving a node changes its location but never its sid, so no reference by sid breaks
findings.why: «the sid itself» и «which means that» — кальки «сам sid» и «а значит, что», и предложение выходит длиннее нужного.
findings.title: A node is cited by its sid

findings.was: Nobody sees that a reason has stopped holding
findings.proposed: Nobody notices that a reason no longer holds
findings.why: «has stopped holding» — калька «перестало держаться»; идиоматично «no longer holds».
findings.title: A rule is made of its text and its reason

findings.was: None of it is kept in a document of its own.
findings.proposed: None of it is kept in a separate document.
findings.why: «a document of its own» двусмысленно (собственный документ у узла или у каждого пункта); носитель скажет «a separate document».
findings.title: Everything that bears on a node is kept in that node

findings.was: A todo is work put off that concerns
findings.proposed: A todo is deferred work that concerns
findings.why: «work put off that» — разорванная калька «отложенная работа»; естественно «deferred work».
findings.title: A todo is kept on a node it concerns

findings.was: an item of the `meta.todos`
findings.proposed: an item in the `meta.todos`
findings.why: Об элементе списка говорят «an item in», а не «an item of».
findings.title: A todo is kept on a node it concerns

findings.was: what still waits on it
findings.proposed: what work on it is still pending
findings.why: «waits on» по-английски значит «обслуживает» или «зависит от», а не «ещё ждёт по нему».
findings.title: A todo is kept on a node it concerns

findings.was: Left once done or given up, it shows work waiting that no longer waits.
findings.proposed: Left in place once done or given up, it still shows the work as pending.
findings.why: «shows work waiting that no longer waits» — калька, вызывающая улыбку, а «Left» без «in place» читается как «ушедший».
findings.title: A todo is kept on a node it concerns

findings.was: it leaves no copy behind to show work that no longer waits
findings.proposed: it leaves behind no copy that would still show the work as pending
findings.why: «work that no longer waits» — та же калька «работа, которая больше не ждёт»; работа по-английски не «ждёт».
findings.title: A todo is kept on a node it concerns

findings.was: The one source of truth is the specification
findings.proposed: The single source of truth is the specification
findings.why: Устойчивое выражение — «single source of truth», а «the one source» звучит как «тот самый источник».
findings.title: The one source of truth is the specification, not the code

findings.was: The one source of truth about the system
findings.proposed: The single source of truth about the system
findings.why: Устойчивое выражение — «single source of truth».
findings.title: The one source of truth is the specification, not the code

findings.was: The code implements it and holds nothing of its own.
findings.proposed: The code implements it and contains nothing of its own.
findings.why: «holds» — калька «держит»; о содержимом кода говорят «contains».
findings.title: The one source of truth is the specification, not the code

findings.was: It is repaired when the rule is revised.
findings.proposed: The defect is fixed when the rule is revised.
findings.why: Дефект по-английски «fix», а не «repair», и «It» можно отнести и к правилу, и к дефекту.
findings.title: The one source of truth is the specification, not the code

findings.was: which of them holds
findings.proposed: which of them is right
findings.why: «holds» для «верен» неясно: читается как «какой из них держится».
findings.title: The one source of truth is the specification, not the code

findings.was: the disagreement is found by a machine
findings.proposed: any disagreement is found by a machine
findings.why: Определённый артикль указывает на конкретное расхождение, которого в тексте нет; нужно «any».
findings.title: The one source of truth is the specification, not the code

findings.was: the glue a framework needs
findings.proposed: the glue code a framework needs
findings.why: «glue» без «code» — жаргон; термин — «glue code».
findings.title: Only what the rules require is done

findings.was: Technical code adds nothing the system does.
findings.proposed: Technical code adds nothing to what the system does.
findings.why: Без «to what» фраза грамматически неполна и читается как «добавляет ничего из того, что система делает».
findings.title: Only what the rules require is done

findings.was: Only its owners approve a node
findings.proposed: Only a node's owners approve it
findings.why: Местоимение «its» стоит раньше слова, к которому относится, и заголовок спотыкается.

findings.was: someone who answers for a rule
findings.proposed: someone accountable for a rule
findings.why: «answers for» у носителя ассоциируется с «ответить за содеянное»; об ответственности за правило — «accountable for».

findings.was: Named, whoever approved is compared with the node's owners.
findings.proposed: A named approver is checked against the node's owners.
findings.why: Висящее «Named,» и «compared with» — кальки; сверку по-английски выражают «checked against».

findings.was: the fields the node's kind adds beside them
findings.proposed: the fields the node's kind adds alongside them
findings.why: «adds beside them» неидиоматично; естественно «alongside them».
findings.title: What an approval covers

findings.was: An approval stands through a change to:
findings.proposed: An approval survives a change to:
findings.why: «stands through» так не употребляется; естественно «survives».
findings.title: What an approval covers

findings.was: The SpecSheriff tools build a section's approval status
findings.proposed: The SpecSheriff tools derive a section's approval status
findings.why: Статус по-английски не «строят»; его «derive» или «compute».
findings.title: How a section's approval status is determined

findings.was: They build it anew after every change
findings.proposed: They recompute it after every change
findings.why: «build it anew» — калька «строят заново»; о вычисляемом значении говорят «recompute».
findings.title: How a section's approval status is determined

findings.was: Nobody writes it by hand.
findings.proposed: Nobody sets it by hand.
findings.why: Статус не «пишут», а «set».
findings.title: How a section's approval status is determined

findings.was: where its wording changes only:
findings.proposed: where the node's wording changes only:
findings.why: «its» можно отнести к агенту или к ответственному; надёжнее назвать узел.
findings.title: An agent approves in an owner's name a wording that states nothing new

findings.was: leaves the owners nothing to choose
findings.proposed: leaves the owners nothing to decide
findings.why: «nothing to choose» неидиоматично; естественно «nothing to decide».
findings.title: An agent approves in an owner's name a wording that states nothing new

findings.was: would only spend their attention
findings.proposed: would only waste their attention
findings.why: «spend their attention» — калька «потратить внимание»; по-английски внимание «waste».
findings.title: An agent approves in an owner's name a wording that states nothing new

findings.was: It names whoever made it.
findings.proposed: The withdrawal names whoever made it.
findings.why: Два «it» подряд, и первое можно прочесть как узел из предыдущего предложения.
findings.title: Who may withdraw a node's approval

findings.was: So neither is anyone's to withdraw.
findings.proposed: So neither is for just anyone to withdraw.
findings.why: «neither is anyone's to withdraw» по-английски значит «никто не вправе отозвать», а по смыслу — «отозвать может не всякий».
findings.title: Who may withdraw a node's approval

findings.was: the status indicates the combined state of the whole group of rules inside it
findings.proposed: the status sums up the state of all the rules inside it
findings.why: «indicates the combined state of the whole group» — нагромождение существительных, калька «является индикатором совокупного состояния».
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: the whole group has that status
findings.proposed: the section is a draft too
findings.why: Статус принадлежит разделу, а не «группе», и «has that status» — калька.
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: , the code and the tests secondary in it.
findings.proposed: , with the code and the tests secondary.
findings.why: Оборот без глагола и с лишним «in it» читается как ошибка.
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: implementing it would fix its incompleteness in the code, or the code would be built on guesses
findings.proposed: implementing it would either lock its gaps into the code or build the code on guesses
findings.why: «fix» — ложный друг «закрепить»: по-английски это «исправить», и фраза читается наоборот.
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: also holds code and tests written earlier, which must be brought to the form the method describes
findings.proposed: also has code and tests written earlier, which must be brought into the form the method describes
findings.why: «holds code» — калька «содержит»; проект код «has», а к форме приводят «into».
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: Only what a commit leaves alone is relieved
findings.proposed: Only what a commit leaves alone may keep its earlier form
findings.why: «is relieved» значит «испытывает облегчение»; это калька «послабление касается».
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: A status of their own for sections and nodes lets
findings.proposed: Giving sections and nodes a status of their own lets
findings.why: Подлежащее «A status of their own for sections and nodes» — калька, носитель построит фразу от действия.
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: without withdrawing its status
findings.proposed: without withdrawing its approval
findings.why: Статус не «withdraw»; отзывают одобрение, как и говорит сам метод.
findings.title: What a draft means

findings.was: survives the refactoring that moves
findings.proposed: survives refactoring that moves
findings.why: Определённый артикль указывает на конкретный рефакторинг, а речь о любом.
findings.title: A test's reference to its rule

findings.was: Code changes only as a consequence of the specification
findings.proposed: Code changes only as a result of a change to the specification
findings.why: «as a consequence of the specification» — калька «вслед за спецификацией»; следствие вызывает изменение спецификации, а не она сама.
findings.note: «after» теряет причинность: код меняется не просто после, а вследствие изменения спецификации.

findings.was: only as a consequence of the specification, not by changing the code directly
findings.proposed: only as a result of a change to the specification, not by editing the code directly
findings.why: Та же калька «вслед за спецификацией»; поведение меняется после изменения спецификации.

findings.was: ensures the code's agreement with the specification and gives certainty that there is always one source of truth
findings.proposed: keeps the code in agreement with the specification and ensures that there is always a single source of truth
findings.why: «gives certainty that» — калька «позволяет быть уверенным», а устойчивое выражение — «single source of truth».

findings.was: covered by the SpecTag of the one it stands in
findings.proposed: covered by the SpecTag of the symbol that encloses it
findings.why: «stands in» — калька «стоит внутри»; по-английски «stand in» значит «замещать».
findings.title: Every code symbol has a SpecTag

findings.was: Code that is technical, holding no business logic, must
findings.proposed: Technical code, which contains no business logic, must
findings.why: «Code that is technical, holding» — громоздкая калька; естественно «Technical code, which contains».
findings.title: Every code symbol has a SpecTag

findings.was: to find gaps at once
findings.proposed: to find gaps immediately
findings.why: «at once» двусмысленно: «сразу» или «все одновременно».
findings.title: Every code symbol has a SpecTag

findings.was: What the checks hold, and when they run
findings.proposed: What the checks enforce, and when they run
findings.why: «hold» — калька «держат»; проверки по-английски «enforce».
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: Every check is deterministic but the review of the code.
findings.proposed: Every check except the review of the code is deterministic.
findings.why: «but» после сказуемого сначала читается как «но», и фраза спотыкается.
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: those rules of the guidelines the table of checks lists
findings.proposed: the rules of the guidelines that the table of checks lists
findings.why: Два именных оборота подряд без «that» читаются с запинкой.
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: they also run after each of its edits
findings.proposed: the checks also run after each of its edits
findings.why: «they» ближе к «the tests or the code», чем к проверкам.
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: run at a push if the specification
findings.proposed: run on a push if the specification
findings.why: О событиях git говорят «on push», а «at a push» звучит неестественно.
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: The tests run at a push rather than at a commit
findings.proposed: The tests run on a push rather than on a commit
findings.why: О событиях git говорят «on push» и «on commit».
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: No test runs at a push while
findings.proposed: No test runs on a push while
findings.why: О событиях git говорят «on push».
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: so refusing costs nobody a judgement
findings.proposed: so a refusal requires nobody's judgement
findings.why: «costs nobody a judgement» — калька «ни от кого не требует суждения», звучит как «никому не стоит суждения».
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: is bypassed at the first chance
findings.proposed: is bypassed at the first opportunity
findings.why: Устойчивое выражение — «at the first opportunity».
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: can be seen only at the edits, since a commit holds the test and the code together
findings.proposed: can be seen only edit by edit, since a commit contains the test and the code together
findings.why: «at the edits» и «holds» — кальки «при правках» и «содержит».
findings.title: What the checks hold, and when they run

findings.was: take the place of the owners above for every node within it
findings.proposed: take the place of the owners at the level above for every node within it
findings.why: «the owners above» можно прочесть как «названные выше в тексте».
findings.title: The owners

findings.was: those who answer for a rule
findings.proposed: those accountable for a rule
findings.why: «answer for» у носителя ассоциируется с «ответить за содеянное»; нужно «accountable for».
findings.title: The owners

findings.was: beyond what one person reads
findings.proposed: beyond what one person can read
findings.why: Без модального глагола теряется смысл «сколько один человек способен прочесть».
findings.title: The owners

findings.was: The owners of one part share its reading.
findings.proposed: The owners of one part share the work of reading it.
findings.why: «its reading» читается как «её толкование».
findings.title: The owners

findings.was: Each of them answers for all of it.
findings.proposed: Each of them is accountable for all of it.
findings.why: «answers for» у носителя ассоциируется с «ответить за содеянное»; нужно «is accountable for».
findings.title: The owners

findings.was: what still waits for them
findings.proposed: what still awaits their decision
findings.why: «waits for them» — калька «их ждёт»; звучит, будто что-то ждёт владельцев лично.
findings.title: The approval status

findings.was: how strictly the checks hold its code and tests
findings.proposed: how strictly the checks apply to its code and tests
findings.why: «hold» — калька «держат»; проверки «apply to» код и тесты.
findings.title: When the status is approved

findings.was: That schema is the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines, with the extension
findings.proposed: That schema is the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines together with the extension
findings.why: Голое "with" читается как «схема, у которой есть расширение»; для «вместе с» нужно "together with".
findings.title: The structure of the specification is defined by its machine-readable schema

findings.was: A file that does not match the schema is refused.
findings.proposed: A file that does not conform to the schema is refused.
findings.why: "match" — калька «соответствует»; о схеме по-английски говорят "conform to".
findings.title: The structure of the specification is defined by its machine-readable schema

findings.was: Named, the property tells the file's author what to correct.
findings.proposed: Naming the property tells the file's author what to correct.
findings.why: Причастие "Named," в начале калькирует «Названное свойство» и звучит как подпись под картинкой.
findings.title: The structure of the specification is defined by its machine-readable schema

findings.was: A project may add to the schema, in its extension of it, its own kinds of node, and properties of a node, a file or a link.
findings.proposed: In its extension of the schema, a project may add its own kinds of node, as well as properties of nodes, files and links.
findings.why: Вставка "in its extension of it" разрывает глагол и дополнение, а запятая перед "and properties" ломает перечень — русский порядок слов.
findings.title: How a project may extend the schema

findings.was: A project changes no definition the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines holds and cannot contradict it.
findings.proposed: A project neither changes a definition in the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines nor contradicts that schema.
findings.why: "holds" вместо «содержит», "cannot" читается как невозможность, а не запрет, и "it" неясно — определение или схема.
findings.title: How a project may extend the schema

findings.was: changes no definition of the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines
findings.proposed: changes no definition in the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines
findings.why: "definition of the schema" значит «определение самой схемы»; нужно "definition in the schema".
findings.title: How a project may extend the schema

findings.was: So a tool relying on one of them is never wrong there.
findings.proposed: So a tool relying on one of those structures is never wrong in any project.
findings.why: "them" может значить и guidelines, и структуры, а "there" повисает без опоры — калька «там не ошибается».
findings.title: How a project may extend the schema

findings.was: What the technical appendix holds
findings.proposed: What the technical appendix contains
findings.why: "holds" для «содержит» звучит как «удерживает»; о составе документа говорят "contains".
findings.title: What the technical appendix holds

findings.was: The technical appendix holds:
findings.proposed: The technical appendix contains:
findings.why: "holds" для «содержит» звучит как «удерживает»; о составе документа говорят "contains".
findings.title: What the technical appendix holds

findings.was: the implementation of a rule is looked for in one place
findings.proposed: a reader looks for the implementation of a rule in one place
findings.why: Пассив "is looked for" — тяжёлая калька неопределённо-личного «ищут»; носитель назовёт того, кто ищет.
findings.title: What the technical appendix holds

findings.was: so they stand in one section, which spans the system as the stack does
findings.proposed: so they are kept in one section, which spans the whole system as the stack does
findings.why: "stand in one section" — калька «стоят в разделе»; записи "are kept in" раздел, а «всю систему» — "the whole system".
findings.title: What the technical appendix holds

findings.was: A shortcoming is not how a rule is carried out
findings.proposed: A shortcoming is not how a rule is implemented
findings.why: Правило реализуют ("implement"), а не "carry out"; в первом абзаце того же обоснования сказано "implemented".
findings.title: What the technical appendix holds

findings.was: It does so in enough detail to be read only one way
findings.proposed: It does so in enough detail to be read in only one way
findings.why: Без предлога "in" оборот разговорный и спотыкается при чтении.
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: It never restates what they state.
findings.proposed: It never restates what those nodes state.
findings.why: Сразу после перечня "exact values, examples and the edge cases" местоимение "they" цепляется за него, а не за узлы базы.
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: which stands in the section of the stack;
findings.proposed: which goes in the section on the stack;
findings.why: "stands in the section of the stack" — двойная калька «стоит в разделе стека»; естественно "goes in the section on the stack".
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: would leave the base binding nowhere
findings.proposed: would leave the base without force anywhere
findings.why: "leave the base binding nowhere" — калька «лишила бы силы везде», читается с запинкой.
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: Read beside the nodes it implements, an appendix node restating them
findings.proposed: Read alongside the nodes it implements, an appendix node restating them
findings.why: Документы читают "alongside" друг друга, а "beside" — чисто пространственное «рядом».
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: a copy drifts from what it copies
findings.proposed: a copy drifts away from what it copies
findings.why: "drift from" без "away" звучит обрубленно; носитель скажет "drifts away from".
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: is found when that rule changes and is read beside it.
findings.proposed: is found when that rule changes, and is read alongside it.
findings.why: Без запятой "and is read beside it" прочитывается как продолжение "that rule changes", а "beside" — пространственное «рядом».
findings.title: How the technical appendix relates to the base specification

findings.was: the tools that ensure those rules are carried out
findings.proposed: the tools that enforce those rules
findings.why: Правила не "carry out" — их соблюдают; «обеспечивающие выполнение правил» по-английски "enforce".
findings.title: The structure of the guidelines

findings.was: The rules state what is held, what is checked
findings.proposed: The rules state what is stored, what is checked
findings.why: "what is held" двусмысленно (ещё и «что верно»); «что хранится» — "what is stored".
findings.title: The structure of the guidelines

findings.was: The requirements for the tools stand in the appendix of the tools.
findings.proposed: The requirements for the tools are set out in the appendix of the tools.
findings.why: "stand in" — калька «стоят в»; требования в документе "are set out in".
findings.title: The structure of the guidelines

findings.was: It describes how one toolset carries those rules out:
findings.proposed: It describes how one toolset implements those rules:
findings.why: Набор инструментов правила реализует ("implements"); "carries out" здесь — калька «выполняет».
findings.title: The structure of the guidelines

findings.was: The tools can change while the rule they carry out stays, so the requirements for them stand apart from the rules.
findings.proposed: The tools can change while the rule they implement stays the same, so the requirements for them are kept apart from the rules.
findings.why: "stays" без дополнения и "stand apart" — кальки «остаётся» и «стоят отдельно»; носитель скажет "stays the same" и "are kept apart".
findings.title: The structure of the guidelines

findings.was: The appendix of the tools carries out the guidelines
findings.proposed: The appendix of the tools implements the guidelines
findings.why: Документ не может "carry out" правила; в русском «реализует» — "implements".
findings.title: The appendix of the tools carries out the guidelines

findings.was: the rules of the guidelines it carries out
findings.proposed: the rules of the guidelines it implements
findings.why: Документ не может "carry out" правила; это калька «выполняет», по смыслу "implements".
findings.title: The appendix of the tools carries out the guidelines

findings.was: the rules it carries out can drift apart unseen
findings.proposed: the rules it implements can drift apart unnoticed
findings.why: "carries out" для документа — калька, а «незаметно» по-английски "unnoticed", не "unseen".
findings.title: The appendix of the tools carries out the guidelines

findings.was: made of the rules every project shares
findings.proposed: made up of the rules every project shares
findings.why: "made of" говорят о материале; о составных частях — "made up of".
findings.title: A project's own guidelines

findings.was: which hold what only its specification needs, such as the specification's owners
findings.proposed: which set out what only its specification needs, such as who owns the specification
findings.why: Guidelines не могут "hold" людей-владельцев; естественно «устанавливают… например, кто владеет спецификацией».
findings.title: A project's own guidelines

findings.was: Beyond what the SpecSheriff guidelines require there, a project may add rules of its own where it needs them.
findings.proposed: Beyond what the SpecSheriff guidelines require of a project's own guidelines, the project may add rules of its own where it needs them.
findings.why: "there" повисает: неясно, где именно — калька «там».
findings.title: A project's own guidelines

findings.was: let a tool, a skill or a reader carry from one project to the next
findings.proposed: let a tool, a skill or a reader carry over from one project to the next
findings.why: Непереходное "carry" без "over" не значит «переходить»; идиома — "carry over".
findings.title: A project's own guidelines

findings.was: without reading that project's own.
findings.proposed: without reading that project's own rules.
findings.why: "own" без существительного обрывает фразу.
findings.title: A project's own guidelines

findings.was: A project's interaction with the SpecSheriff guidelines
findings.proposed: How a project uses the SpecSheriff guidelines
findings.why: "interaction with" документом — калька «взаимодействие»; с текстом не взаимодействуют, его используют.
findings.title: A project's interaction with the SpecSheriff guidelines

findings.was: and makes no copy of them, except SpecSheriff itself, where they are written.
findings.proposed: and makes no copy of them, unless the project is SpecSheriff itself, where they are written.
findings.why: "except SpecSheriff itself" после "makes no copy of them" читается как исключение из копий, а не из проектов.
findings.title: A project's interaction with the SpecSheriff guidelines

findings.was: Because they come whole with the plugin
findings.proposed: Because they come in full with the plugin
findings.why: "come whole" — калька «приходят целиком», звучит странно.
findings.title: A project's interaction with the SpecSheriff guidelines

findings.was: in every project working by one release
findings.proposed: in every project on the same release
findings.why: "working by one release" — калька «работающем на одном релизе»; "one release" к тому же читается как «один-единственный релиз».
findings.title: A project's interaction with the SpecSheriff guidelines

findings.was: a second version that nobody who writes them reads
findings.proposed: a second version that none of their authors reads
findings.why: Нагромождение "nobody who writes them reads" носитель перечитывает дважды.
findings.title: A project's interaction with the SpecSheriff guidelines

findings.was: What the sections share is agreed in contracts
findings.proposed: What the sections share is agreed in the contracts section
findings.why: Строчное "contracts" без артикля читается как «в договорах» (нарицательное множественное), а не как имя раздела.
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: Contracts agrees what the sections of the specification share:
findings.proposed: The contracts section agrees on what the sections of the specification share:
findings.why: Строчное "contracts" читается как множественное число, и "Contracts agrees" выглядит ошибкой согласования; к тому же "agree" здесь требует "on".
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: What only one section needs, that section holds itself, except a term
findings.proposed: What only one section needs stays in that section, except a term
findings.why: "that section holds itself" буквально значит «раздел держит самого себя» — русский вынос дополнения вперёд.
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: Contracts exists where the rules of the specification share something
findings.proposed: The contracts section exists where the rules of the specification share something
findings.why: "Contracts exists" выглядит ошибкой согласования: строчное "contracts" читается как множественное число.
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: It stands as a section of its own within the base specification.
findings.proposed: It is a section of its own within the base specification.
findings.why: "stands as a section" — калька «стоит/является»; достаточно "is".
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: A specification with no term and nothing else shared needs none.
findings.proposed: A specification with no term and nothing else shared does not need it.
findings.why: "needs none" после "no term and nothing else" непонятно к чему относится — к терминам или к контрактам.
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: or their own rules for one matter
findings.proposed: or make their own rules for the same matter
findings.why: Правила не "coin" (так говорят о словах), а «для одного и того же» — "for the same matter", не "for one matter".
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: Holding in contracts only what binds more than one section keeps contracts from answering for
findings.proposed: Keeping in the contracts section only what binds more than one section keeps that section from answering for
findings.why: Строчное "contracts" читается как «договоры», а "Holding in" — калька «держать в»; естественно "Keeping in".
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: Contracts exists only to agree what the parts
findings.proposed: The contracts section exists only to agree on what the parts
findings.why: "Contracts exists" выглядит ошибкой согласования, а "agree" здесь требует "on".
findings.title: What the sections share is agreed in contracts

findings.was: A term is defined once, in contracts
findings.proposed: A term is defined once, in the contracts section
findings.why: Строчное "in contracts" читается как «в договорах», а не как имя раздела.
findings.title: A term is defined once, in contracts

findings.was: they are added to contracts
findings.proposed: they are added to the contracts section
findings.why: Строчное "added to contracts" читается как «добавляются в договоры».
findings.title: A term is defined once, in contracts

findings.was: or two terms naming one, is refused.
findings.proposed: or two terms naming one, are refused.
findings.why: При "or" глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим — "two terms" требует "are".
findings.title: A term is defined once, in contracts

findings.was: whether two words mean one thing
findings.proposed: whether two words mean the same thing
findings.why: «одно и то же» — "the same thing"; "one thing" звучит как «одну вещь».
findings.title: A term is defined once, in contracts

findings.was: So a term names a quantity, and a rule states how it is computed.
findings.proposed: For example, a term names a quantity, and a rule states how it is computed.
findings.why: «Так,» в значении примера — "For example"; английское "So" значит «следовательно».
findings.title: What a term states

findings.was: Behaviour held in a term
findings.proposed: Behaviour written into a term
findings.why: Поведение не "held in" термином; «записанное в термине» — "written into".
findings.title: What a term states

findings.was: The link stands in the node's `refs` list, apart from the citation.
findings.proposed: The link is kept in the node's `refs` list, apart from the citation.
findings.why: "stands in the list" — калька «стоит в списке»; запись в списке "is kept in".
findings.title: A cited node is also linked

findings.was: when any of its properties holds `§` followed by that node's sid, text quoted as code included.
findings.proposed: when any of its properties contains `§` followed by that node's sid, even in text formatted as code.
findings.why: "holds" вместо «содержит» и абсолютный оборот "text quoted as code included" — кальки; «оформленный как код» — "formatted as code".
findings.title: A cited node is also linked

findings.was: These properties are not considered:
findings.proposed: The following properties are ignored:
findings.why: "are not considered" можно прочесть как «не считаются свойствами»; перед списком естественно "The following … are ignored".
findings.title: A cited node is also linked

findings.was: They stand in the same list as the links the node declares
findings.proposed: They are kept in the same list as the links the node declares
findings.why: "stand in the same list" — калька «стоят в том же списке».
findings.title: Incoming links are built

findings.was: which reverses a ratio (§s-bckzdwd35d2nefa)
findings.proposed: which reverses its ratio (§s-bckzdwd35d2nefa)
findings.why: Речь о соотношении этой самой связи — нужно "its", а не неопределённое "a".
findings.title: Incoming links are built

findings.was: No link it declares is built into another node.
findings.proposed: No link it declares is mirrored in another node.
findings.why: "built into" значит «встроен как составная часть», а не «отражён входящей записью».
findings.title: Incoming links are built

findings.was: in every project working by one release
findings.proposed: in every project on the same release
findings.why: "working by one release" — калька «работающем на одном релизе»; "one release" к тому же читается как «один-единственный релиз».
findings.title: Incoming links are built

findings.was: A list in them of the links one project makes to them would hold true of that project alone.
findings.proposed: If they listed the links one project makes to them, the list would hold true of that project alone.
findings.why: "A list in them of the links … to them" — разорванная русская конструкция, носитель путается в двух "them".
findings.title: Incoming links are built

findings.was: Of a user interface the base states what it shows, not how it looks
findings.proposed: For a user interface, the base states what it shows, not how it looks
findings.why: Вынос "Of a user interface" в начало — калька «О пользовательском интерфейсе»; по-английски "For a user interface,".

findings.was: Of a user interface, the base specification states
findings.proposed: For a user interface, the base specification states
findings.why: Вынос "Of a user interface" в начало — калька «О пользовательском интерфейсе»; по-английски "For a user interface,".

findings.was: what a user can rely on in any instance:
findings.proposed: what a user can rely on in any instance of the system:
findings.why: "in any instance" — устойчивое «в любом случае»; без "of the system" инстанс не прочитывается.

findings.was: the sort of control
findings.proposed: the kind of control
findings.why: "sort" в спецификации звучит разговорно; естественно "kind of control".

findings.was: The same rules can then be given another look with an appendix of its own.
findings.proposed: The same rules can then be given a different look, with an appendix of its own.
findings.why: "give … another look" — идиома «взглянуть ещё раз», а не «оформить иначе».

findings.was: The section of the technical debt lists
findings.proposed: The technical debt section lists
findings.why: "section of the technical debt" — калька родительного падежа «раздел технического долга».
findings.title: Technical debt

findings.was: Standing there is the whole of the choice to accept the shortcoming:
findings.proposed: Being listed there is the whole of the choice to accept the shortcoming:
findings.why: "Standing there" — калька «нахождение там»; носитель прочтёт «стоя там».
findings.title: Technical debt

findings.was: Every link names what it means by a type.
findings.proposed: Every link names what it means through its type.
findings.why: "what it means by a type" читается как «что связь понимает под словом type».
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: the linking node is how the linked one is carried out.
findings.proposed: the linking node shows how the linked one is carried out.
findings.why: Узел не может «быть способом»; в русском «показывает, как» — "shows how".
findings.title: What a link is
findings.note: «the linking node is how the linked one is carried out» — естественный оборот; «shows how» меняет смысл.

findings.was: the linking node holds a condition the linked rule depends on
findings.proposed: the linking node states a condition the linked rule depends on
findings.why: "holds" рядом с "condition" читается как «условие выполняется»; «содержит условие» — "states a condition".
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: the linking node, of an extension, changes the linked main rule
findings.proposed: the linking node, which belongs to an extension, changes the linked main rule
findings.why: Обособленное "of an extension" — калька «узел расширения», по-английски так не вставляют.
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: So it holds no link of another type to it.
findings.proposed: So the linking node has no link of another type to the linked one.
findings.why: Два "it" подряд — непонятно, у кого нет связи и к кому.
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: as an operator starting an export
findings.proposed: such as an operator starting an export
findings.why: "as" вместо "such as" перед примером — калька «как».
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: No check can grade it.
findings.proposed: No check can assess it.
findings.why: "grade" — «ставить оценку» (школьную); «оценить» здесь — "assess".
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: is the same guess one step later
findings.proposed: is the same guess, one step further on
findings.why: «на шаг дальше» — не о времени; "one step later" звучит как «шагом позже».
findings.title: What a link is

findings.was: The archive holds the nodes removed from the specification that an approval was ever given for.
findings.proposed: The archive holds the nodes that were ever approved and have since been removed from the specification.
findings.why: "that an approval was ever given for" цепляется к "specification", а не к "nodes".
findings.title: The archive

findings.was: So is a node no approval was ever given for.
findings.proposed: So is a node that was never approved.
findings.why: "a node no approval was ever given for" — тяжёлая калька; естественно "never approved".
findings.title: The archive

findings.was: records a logic or an approach that was mistaken
findings.proposed: records a line of reasoning or an approach that was mistaken
findings.why: "logic" неисчисляемое, "a logic" звучит странно.
findings.title: The archive

findings.was: A node no approval was ever given for was never implemented, so archived it would only bury
findings.proposed: A node that was never approved was never implemented, so, if archived, it would only bury
findings.why: "so archived it would" читается как «так что [кто-то] заархивировал его»; к тому же тяжёлая конструкция "no approval was ever given for".
findings.title: The archive

findings.was: No other type binds two terms of the specification, `cites` included:
findings.proposed: No other type, not even `cites`, binds two terms of the specification:
findings.why: "`cites` included" после отрицания неуклюже; в отрицании говорят "not even".
findings.title: Links between terms

findings.was: link terms alone
findings.proposed: link only terms
findings.why: "link terms alone" можно понять как «связывают термины сами по себе».
findings.title: Links between terms

findings.was: A ratio is the multiplicity of each end in UML notation
findings.proposed: A ratio gives the multiplicity of each end in UML notation
findings.why: Соотношение — пара значений, а не одна «кратность»; "gives", как в обосновании, снимает это.
findings.title: How a ratio is written

findings.was: A section holds rules
findings.proposed: A section contains rules
findings.why: В этом же наборе hold значит и «содержать», и «быть верным» (9.2, 7.5, 7.16); для вместилища носитель языка пишет contains, и двусмысленность исчезает.
findings.title: A section holds rules and requires nothing

findings.was: A section is a node that holds a group of rules. It holds at least one rule.
findings.proposed: A section is a node that contains a group of rules. It contains at least one rule.
findings.why: То же: holds для «содержит» рядом с holds в смысле «выполняется» читается двояко, contains однозначно.
findings.title: A section holds rules and requires nothing

findings.was: It brings the rules together under a particular logic described in the text of the section itself.
findings.proposed: It brings the rules together on a principle that the section's own text describes.
findings.why: «В рамках определённой логики» передано дословно: under a particular logic по-английски не говорят, а the text of the section itself — калька с «текст самого раздела».
findings.title: A section holds rules and requires nothing

findings.was: for the requirement that the section holds at least one rule:
findings.proposed: for the purposes of the requirement that the section contains at least one rule:
findings.why: «Для требования, чтобы» передано как for the requirement that, тогда как по-английски нужно for the purposes of the requirement, а holds здесь можно прочесть как «выполняется».
findings.title: What is considered a rule of a section

findings.was: - a term the section holds;
findings.proposed: - a term the section contains;
